newsitem.title: USA: TENNIS-AGASSI PUTS U.S. UP 1-0 OVER THE NETHERLANDS.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-AGASSI PUTS U.S. UP 1-0 OVER THE NETHERLANDS.

text.p: Andre Agassi pounded out a 7-6 (8-6) 6-4 7-6 (7-2) victory over Sjeng Schalken to give the U.S a 1-0 lead against the Netherlands in the quartefinal singles Davis Cup tie on Friday..
Jim Courier will try to give the Americans a 2-0 lead when he opposes Jan Siemerink in the second singles match of the day in best of five weekend competition.

Agassi rolled to his 14th straight Davis Cup victory-- two short of American Bill Tilden's record despite losing service eight times because of his ability to handle the windy conditions better than the 21-year old Dutch baseliner at the Palisades Tennis Club.
Agassi is now 23-4 in Davis Cup play.
Agaasi started off like a firecracker running out to a 4-0 lead in the opening set before fizzling as Schalken forced a tiebreaker.
Schalken held a set point at 6-5. But Agassi shook it off and ran off the next three points when the Dutchman's backhand flew long on set point to end th 57-minute opener.
Agassi took the second set breaking Schalken three times.

He led 4-1 before the Dutchman drew to 4-3 with a service break. But Agassi broke for 5-3 in the eighth game to go ahead 5-3. Schalken broke back for 5-4. But Agassi got the decisive break in the next game at love when Schalken sprayed a backhand wide on set point to put the Americans up two sets to love.
In the third set, Schalken built a 5-3 advantage breaking Agassi three times. Agassi fought off three break points to go up 6-5, and when Schalken held, a second tiebreaker was forced.
Agassi raced to a 5-0 lead before Schalken closed to within 5-2. A long backhand by Schalken gave Agassi a set point before a long forehand completed the sweep.
